fields.statement: At 9062cd7f (attempt 2): the attempt-1 finding is fixed: runRunStart checks agent steps on the request's workflow (plan-milestone when --milestone) before resolving the change set, and again only when a plan run on a record change set swaps in plan-milestone; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestRunStartAgentRefusalsBeforeWrite|Milestone|PlanMilestone|RunStart' passes. go test ./internal/workflow passes, incl. TestBuiltinPlanMilestone (steps equal to plan's, every stage owner). Testscripts plan-milestone-workflow (workflow ls lists plan-milestone builtin; dry-run --milestone with rhiza.autonomy.plan=auto shows workflow plan-milestone, not autonomous; daemon starts the milestone request on plan-milestone without --autonomous; a repo plan-milestone.toml with autonomous = true makes the daemon pass --autonomous), plan-milestone-backlog, plan-workflow, plan-workflow-open, plan-workflow-pr, plan-requests, daemon-milestone-request, run-start-new, describe-golden and workflow-ls pass. The four plan scripts now expect the planned change set left proposed, consistent with plan-milestone's owner accept stage. The full internal/api package at load ~12 only failed TestReadBudget (timing budget) and the root usage.live.json leak guard, both environmental and outside this diff.
